title: Tri Cities Golf Club
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Tri-Cities Golf Club has been a key venue for public golf for over 30 years. We offer the best value for golf in the region providing 27 holes with a variety of conditions. With our convenient and easy to get to location, you can be here in minutes from Bristol, Johnson City, Elizabethton or Kingsport. You will use every club in your bag when you decide to play all 27 holes.
